valerius_lattice_under_strain.title: The Lattice Under Strain
valerius_lattice_under_strain.text: The district is no longer failing in one place. Watch patrols, trade routes, and private information now pull on the same lattice. Valerius asks whether you will make the pressure visible or move it quietly.

responses.visible: Make the pressure visible. Institutions can only carry what they are willing to name.
responses.quiet: Move the pressure quietly. A stable route matters more than a clean report.

elara_chrono_crypt_briefing.title: A Map with Two Clocks
elara_chrono_crypt_briefing.text: Elara compares the district records with a map recovered from the old archive. The same route appears to move at two different speeds. She gives you the evidence and asks you not to mistake a clean explanation for a true one.

responses.verify: Record the contradiction and carry both models until the site itself settles the question.
responses.simplify: Choose the model that lets the network act now, then mark what would prove it wrong.

lyra_chrono_crypt_entry.title: The Chrono-Crypt Opens
lyra_chrono_crypt_entry.text: Lyra does not offer trust. She offers a timing window. The lock will open only if you predict the counterphase she is about to create and let her know which part of your model she should challenge.

responses.coordinate: Give me the timing window. I will keep the model honest while you keep it moving.
responses.contest: I will enter on my own timing and use your pattern as a constraint, not a command.

gronk_network_load.title: Repair the Network Load
gronk_network_load.text: Gronk lays the archive map across the forge bench. The problem is not a broken component; it is a load path that fails when every component behaves correctly. He asks you to audit the support route yourself before anyone delegates it.

responses.audit: Measure the load path first. A visible repair is not the same as a stable one.
responses.rush: Open the route now and accept the risk of discovering the weak point under pressure.

silas_network_pressure.title: Who Can Carry the Truth
silas_network_pressure.text: Silas has three routes and only one can carry the counterphase map without turning it into a public weapon. He will not choose for you. He wants to know whether you understand the difference between revealing information and routing leverage.

responses.trusted: Give the map to the person who can act without needing to own the story.
responses.sealed: Keep the map sealed until the commitment point. Fewer people can misuse what fewer people know.

valerius_counterphase_commitment.title: The Commitment Point
valerius_counterphase_commitment.text: Valerius has enough information to act, but not enough to act without cost. The city can be stabilized through visible control or through a quiet handoff that leaves more uncertainty alive. This decision cannot be delegated.

responses.institutional: Commit the Watch to the visible line and accept the cost of public control.
responses.network: Commit the trusted network and accept the cost of a less legible victory.

telluric_echo_confrontation.title: The Telluric Echo
telluric_echo_confrontation.text: The Echo begins to repeat the network back at the city. Every earlier choice is now a support, a cost, or a weakness. The last decision remains yours: stabilize the pattern through institutional force, or preserve the network's ability to adapt.

responses.institutional_reckoning: Hold the line together, knowing the city will remember who paid for its stability.
responses.conditional_reprieve: Leave the network room to change, knowing uncertainty will survive with it.
